name: AI crawler permissions
check_logic: Parse robots.txt with the crawler's own robots parser and evaluate the Allow/Disallow rules for GPTBot, ChatGPT-User, ClaudeBot, Google-Extended and PerplexityBot (falling back to the wildcard rule when no bot-specific rule exists).
scoring: Allowed bots / bots checked × 100; UNKNOWN when robots.txt could not be fetched.
evidence_to_store: Per-bot decision, matched rule, robots.txt URL

name: No CDN/firewall blocking AI crawlers
data_source: Homepage, fetched once per AI-crawler user agent and once with a normal browser user agent
check_logic: Fetches the homepage with a regular browser user agent and again with each AI-crawler user agent (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended); flags a bot-specific block when an AI user agent gets a 403/429 or a body far shorter than the browser fetch.
scoring: Bots with no block / bots checked × 100.
evidence_to_store: Per-bot status code, body length, block verdict

name: llms.txt present, accurate and current
check_logic: Checks whether /llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with non-empty content, extracts its markdown links, verifies a sample resolves, and looks for a freshness/date signal.
scoring: Presence 40% + non-empty/well-formed 20% + sampled links resolve 20% + freshness signal 20%.
evidence_to_store: Status code, section count, sampled link results, freshness signal

name: No login, pop-up or cookie wall covering main content
data_source: Rendered homepage DOM (Playwright-rendered HTML already captured during crawl)
check_logic: Scans the rendered homepage for known consent/login/modal markers (OneTrust, Cookiebot, TrustArc, generic cookie/consent/gdpr/modal/overlay classes and login forms) and cross-checks against how much visible text still made it through rendering.
scoring: No blocking markers = 100; dismissible overlay markers with substantial visible text = 70; overlay markers with very little visible text = 20.
evidence_to_store: Matched overlay markers, rendered word count

name: Sitemap complete, accurate and submitted
data_source: /sitemap.xml or robots.txt Sitemap directives (already fetched during crawl)
check_logic: Uses the sitemap already resolved during crawl (candidates, sources, parsed URLs, parse errors) and checks a sample of listed URLs for a valid response, plus how many of the pages actually crawled are covered by the sitemap.
scoring: Discovery 25% (a sitemap was found) + sampled-URL validity 45% + crawled-page coverage 30%.
evidence_to_store: Sitemap URLs, sampled validity results, coverage ratio, parse errors

name: No broken links, redirect chains or error pages
data_source: A sample of internal links extracted from crawled pages
check_logic: Samples internal links found across crawled pages, requests each, and records 4xx/5xx statuses and redirect-hop counts (3+ hops flagged as a chain).
scoring: Working links / sampled links × 100, with a further deduction for redirect chains.
evidence_to_store: Sampled URL, status code, hop count, verdict

name: Page speed and Core Web Vitals (LCP, INP, CLS)
data_source: Fetch latency and response size already recorded for crawled pages
check_logic: Approximates load performance from the response latency and byte size already recorded while crawling representative pages, since no Lighthouse/Chromium performance run is wired into this build; this is a latency/weight proxy, not a measured LCP/INP/CLS.
scoring: Average fetch latency scored against fixed thresholds (<=800ms=100, <=1800ms=70, <=3000ms=40, slower=20), averaged with a page-weight score.
evidence_to_store: Per-page latency, byte size, derived score

name: Mobile responsiveness and secure HTTPS delivery
check_logic: Check final URL uses HTTPS; follow redirects; verify viewport meta tag and render at mobile width; detect horizontal overflow.
scoring: HTTPS 50% + mobile viewport/render 50%; any critical failure can cap score.
evidence_to_store: Final URL, SSL result, viewport meta, overflow evidence

name: Main content present in page source, not JS-only
data_source: HTML source vs rendered DOM for representative pages
check_logic: Download raw HTML; extract visible text from source; compare with rendered DOM text; calculate source text share.
scoring: Raw visible text / rendered visible text × 100; >=70 good, 40-69 partial, <40 fail (configurable).
evidence_to_store: Raw text chars, rendered text chars, ratio

name: One H1 per page and logical H2/H3 hierarchy
check_logic: Parse H1-H6 sequence; count H1s; detect skipped levels and duplicate structural patterns.
scoring: H1 exactly one = pass; hierarchy skips/duplicates reduce score.
evidence_to_store: H1 count, heading sequence, skipped levels

name: Heading frequency that lets an assistant lift a clean passage
check_logic: Measure words per heading, paragraph size, and whether sections form self-contained answer blocks; flag very long sections with no subheading.
scoring: Score based on heading density and average section length; LLM can classify liftability.
evidence_to_store: Heading count, words per section, AI liftability verdict

name: Tables and lists as real markup rather than images
check_logic: Count semantic <table>, <ul>, <ol> elements; detect image-based/table-like visuals using alt/text where possible; optionally flag missing semantic alternatives.
scoring: Semantic structures / detected list-table opportunities × 100; image-only representations reduce score.
evidence_to_store: Table/list counts, suspected image-only structures

name: Text-to-code ratio and content depth per page
check_logic: Calculate visible text characters/HTML characters and word count; compare against page type thresholds.
scoring: Text chars / HTML chars × 100; depth is normalized against configurable page-type benchmark.
evidence_to_store: Text chars, HTML chars, ratio, word count

name: Image alt text and video transcripts
check_logic: Count images with meaningful alt; detect video embeds and transcript blocks; verify transcripts are indexable text when present.
scoring: Images with usable alt / total images × 100; videos with transcript / detected videos × 100; combine.
evidence_to_store: Image URL, alt value, video URL, transcript presence

name: Published and updated dates visible and in code
data_source: Meta tags, JSON-LD, visible page content
check_logic: Extract datePublished/dateModified, article metadata and visible dates; compare values where multiple signals exist.
scoring: Valid current date signal = 100; partial/one source = 60; absent = 0.
evidence_to_store: Date source, parsed dates, consistency result

name: Organization markup — logo, address, contact, profiles
check_logic: Find Organization schema; validate required/expected properties including name, url, logo, address/contact and sameAs profiles.
scoring: Field completeness / expected fields × 100; invalid JSON-LD caps score.
evidence_to_store: Schema type, fields present/missing

name: Page-type markup — Article, FAQ, Service, Product, Person, HowTo
check_logic: Identify page-type schema relevant to URL; compare markup type with visible page template.
scoring: Relevant page-type markup present and consistent = 100; present but mismatched = 50; absent when expected = 0.
evidence_to_store: Schema types, page type inference, mismatch evidence

name: Author profiles marked up with real credentials
check_logic: Detect author byline and profile; extract name, role, credentials, profile URL; verify profile is reachable.
scoring: Author found 50%; profile linked 20%; credentials/role 30%; LLM can assess relevance.
evidence_to_store: Author name, profile URL, credential fields

name: Markup validates cleanly and matches visible content
check_logic: Parse every JSON-LD block; flag syntax/schema errors and materially mismatched values versus visible page/entity values.
scoring: Valid blocks / total blocks × 100, with mismatch penalties.
evidence_to_store: Block index, parse status, mismatched fields

name: One clean URL per page; duplicates resolved
check_logic: Check canonical tag, trailing slash variants, case variants, query parameters, redirect destination and duplicate content clusters.
scoring: Canonical correctness 50%; redirect consistency 25%; duplicate URL conflicts 25%.
evidence_to_store: Canonical URL, final URL, duplicate cluster ID

name: hreflang set correctly for every target country
check_logic: Extract all hreflang tags; validate reciprocal references, valid locale syntax and reachable targets; if no multi-market intent detected, mark NOT APPLICABLE rather than fail.
scoring: Valid reciprocal hreflang pairs / expected pairs × 100; N/A when single-market.
evidence_to_store: Locales, target URLs, reciprocal result

name: Page titles and meta descriptions present and unique
data_source: <title> and meta description on crawled pages
check_logic: Extract title/meta; check presence, uniqueness, length range and duplicate rate.
scoring: Presence 50% + uniqueness 25% + length quality 25%.
evidence_to_store: Page URL, title, description, duplicate group

name: Headings phrased as buyer questions
check_logic: Collects meaningful H1-H3 headings on service/solution pages (excluding short nav-style labels) and classifies each as question-phrased using the same question detector used elsewhere in the engine.
scoring: Question-phrased headings / eligible headings × 100.
evidence_to_store: Heading text, page URL, question verdict

name: Self-contained 40–60 word answer under each question
check_logic: For each question-style heading, capture the next answer block until next heading; evaluate whether it directly answers and is self-contained; measure word count.
scoring: Answer quality 60% + 40–60 word compliance 40%; average across eligible questions.
evidence_to_store: Question, extracted answer, word count, AI score

name: Clear definition sentences for every core concept
check_logic: Extract core service/technology concepts; detect explicit definitions; ask LLM to verify definition clarity and completeness.
scoring: Defined core concepts / core concepts × 100; AI confidence weighted.
evidence_to_store: Concept list, definition sentence, verdict

name: Conclusion first, supporting detail after
check_logic: Evaluate whether the page states the main answer/value proposition before supporting detail; avoid generic introductions.
scoring: LLM score 0–100 based on directness, specificity and answer-first structure.
evidence_to_store: Opening text, AI rationale, score

name: FAQ section on every service and solution page
check_logic: Identify page type; check visible FAQ section and/or FAQPage schema; do not require FAQ on unrelated pages.
scoring: Service pages with FAQ / service pages × 100.
evidence_to_store: URL, page type, FAQ heading, FAQ schema

name: FAQ schema validity and answer consistency
check_logic: Compare schema questions/answers against visible FAQ; validate JSON; flag missing, extra or materially inconsistent items.
scoring: Valid schema 50% + visible/schema consistency 50%.
evidence_to_store: Schema entries, visible entries, mismatch details

name: Comparison and specification tables where buyers evaluate
check_logic: Detect buyer-evaluation intents such as vs, alternatives, pricing, features, capabilities; check whether a real table exists and includes comparable attributes.
scoring: Eligible pages with useful comparison table / eligible pages × 100; AI judges usefulness.
evidence_to_store: Page URL, intent, table presence, field quality

name: Lists and numbered steps that support answer extraction
check_logic: Detect ordered/unordered lists; determine whether they represent procedures, benefits or evaluation criteria rather than decorative lists.
scoring: Useful lists / eligible list opportunities × 100.
evidence_to_store: List count, list purpose, usefulness

name: Natural, conversational phrasing rather than keyword strings
check_logic: Computes a lexical repetition/keyword-stuffing penalty per page and, when the LLM is available, asks it to judge whether a sample of the copy reads as natural and fluent versus stitched-together keyword strings; the LLM verdict blends with the lexical score.
scoring: Lexical score 100 minus a repetition penalty; if LLM usable, Score = lexical × 0.4 + LLM naturalness × 0.6.
evidence_to_store: Repetition density, sampled text, LLM naturalness verdict

name: Keyword stuffing / unnatural repetition
check_logic: Compute unigram/bigram frequency, repeated phrase density and concentration by section; flag abnormal repetition against site/page benchmark.
scoring: Penalty score from density and repetition z-score.
evidence_to_store: Top repeated terms, density, penalty

name: Content depth and completeness
check_logic: Compare page coverage against expected intent topics; identify missing subtopics, unanswered questions and unsupported claims.
scoring: Coverage score = covered expected topics / expected topics × 100; LLM confidence weighted.
evidence_to_store: Topic checklist, missing topics, score

name: Original, citable data point on major pages
check_logic: Extract statistics; determine whether they appear original to the company and whether a citation/source context is supplied.
scoring: Major pages with >=1 credible data point / major pages × 100; LLM assesses originality/context.
evidence_to_store: Statistic, context, source text, AI verdict

name: Named author with role, credentials and real profile
check_logic: Extract author name, role, credentials and profile; verify link and profile consistency.
scoring: Completeness score across required fields; LLM optional for credential relevance.
evidence_to_store: Author fields, profile URL, completeness

name: Named clients, quantified outcomes, deployment detail
check_logic: Detect client references, numbers/results, deployment context, time frame and solution details; classify evidence strength.
scoring: Evidence score: client 25% + quantified outcome 30% + deployment detail 25% + context 20%.
evidence_to_store: Client mention, KPI, deployment detail, AI score

name: Claims sourced and dated to a primary source
check_logic: Extract factual claims and nearby citations; resolve linked sources; assess whether sources appear primary and dated/current.
scoring: Sourced claims / material claims × 100; LLM classifies primary-source quality.
evidence_to_store: Claim text, URL, date, primary-source verdict

name: Reviewer or technical approver named where it matters
check_logic: Detect reviewer/reviewed-by signals and named technical approver; assess whether reviewer role is relevant to topic.
scoring: Relevant pages with qualified reviewer / pages requiring review × 100.
evidence_to_store: Reviewer name, role, relevance score

name: Last substantive update within topic shelf life
check_logic: Extract modified dates; classify topic shelf life; optionally compare current claims against dates and version text.
scoring: Fresh pages / pages with freshness expectation × 100; LLM can judge whether update is substantive.
evidence_to_store: Last updated date, topic class, freshness verdict

name: Buying-journey coverage across discovery to decision
check_logic: Classify pages into awareness, qualification, comparison, objection, trust and decision stages; find missing stages.
scoring: Covered stages / 6 × 100; LLM confidence weighted.
evidence_to_store: Page-to-stage mapping, gaps

name: Best X for Y and X vs Y pages per industry/market
check_logic: Detect comparison/best-for content patterns across target services, industries and markets; identify missing high-intent combinations.
scoring: Covered target combinations / expected combinations × 100.
evidence_to_store: Existing combinations, missing combinations

name: No two pages competing for the same question (cannibalization)
data_source: All crawled page titles, headings and body embeddings
check_logic: Generate question/intent representations for pages; compute pairwise similarity; ask LLM to confirm whether high-similarity pages compete.
scoring: Penalty for confirmed overlapping intents; e.g. similarity >0.85 requires review.
evidence_to_store: Page pair, similarity, shared intent, recommendation

name: No thin or near-duplicate pages diluting the topic
check_logic: Compute word count and content fingerprints; compare near-duplicate similarity; flag thin pages relative to page type.
scoring: Thinness + duplicate penalties; configurable thresholds by template.
evidence_to_store: Page word count, duplicate cluster, similarity

name: Brand named alongside category, industry and geography
check_logic: Check co-occurrence of brand name with relevant category, industry/service and geography; LLM verifies semantic association rather than simple proximity.
scoring: Pages satisfying all required entity associations / eligible pages × 100.
evidence_to_store: Brand/category/industry/geo evidence

name: Wikidata entry present and accurate
check_logic: Search for organization entity; compare website, name, aliases and key facts; LLM resolves ambiguous entity matches.
scoring: Presence 40% + identity match 30% + field accuracy 30%.
evidence_to_store: Entity ID, matched fields, mismatch list

name: Wikipedia or comparable reference source
check_logic: Search for authoritative reference pages about the company; evaluate whether page is genuinely about the organization and what is cited.
scoring: Presence 50% + source authority 30% + entity accuracy 20%.
evidence_to_store: Source URL, source type, entity match

name: Google Knowledge Panel presence and consistency
data_source: Wikidata entity (many Knowledge Panels are Wikidata-backed)
check_logic: Google's own Knowledge Panel surface cannot be reliably scraped; this check uses the same Wikidata organization entity resolved for OFF-01 as a proxy signal and compares its populated fields against the company's own site.
scoring: Presence 50% + fact consistency 50%; UNKNOWN when no Wikidata entity is resolved, matching the framework's own guidance to mark this UNKNOWN when the panel cannot be reliably observed.
evidence_to_store: Entity ID, matched fields, proxy note

name: Company profiles complete and consistent across LinkedIn/Crunchbase/Bloomberg/ZoomInfo
data_source: Public search results for the company name scoped to linkedin.com, crunchbase.com, bloomberg.com and zoominfo.com
check_logic: Runs one search for the company name scoped to the four platform domains and records which platforms return a public profile result; no licensed profile-data API is connected, so field-level completeness is not verified.
scoring: Platforms with a discoverable public profile / 4 × 100.
evidence_to_store: Query, platform hits, matched URLs

name: Company name, address and details identical across sources
check_logic: Build canonical identity record from website; compare NAP and company attributes across sources; classify material vs cosmetic differences.
scoring: Matching fields / fields checked × 100; weighted by importance.
evidence_to_store: Canonical vs source values, mismatch severity

name: Certifications verifiable off-site (CMMI, ISO, partner tiers)
check_logic: Extract certification claims from site; search authoritative issuer records; verify company name, certificate type and current validity.
scoring: Verified claims / claimed certs × 100.
evidence_to_store: Claim, issuer URL, verification result

name: G2, Clutch, Gartner Peer Insights and TrustRadius completeness
data_source: Public search results scoped to g2.com, clutch.co, gartner.com and trustradius.com
check_logic: Runs one search for the company name scoped to the four review-platform domains and records which platforms return a discoverable profile page.
scoring: Platforms with a discoverable profile / 4 × 100.
evidence_to_store: Query, platform hits, matched URLs

name: Review volume, recency and velocity versus competitors
data_source: Search-result counts for the company across review platforms (G2, Clutch, Gartner Peer Insights, TrustRadius)
check_logic: Uses the number of review-platform search hits found as a coarse volume proxy; no review API is connected, so per-review recency, velocity and a named competitor benchmark are not measured -- this is flagged clearly in the evidence.
scoring: Volume proxy scaled 0-100 from hit count; capped at 60 because recency/velocity/competitor comparison are not verified.
evidence_to_store: Query, hit count, cap note

name: Category placement matching how the company positions itself
check_logic: Searches for the company on review/directory platforms, extracts the surrounding result snippets, and compares the categories implied there against the site's own derived categories; the LLM judges semantic equivalence when available.
scoring: Heuristic keyword overlap, replaced by the LLM's match verdict when usable.
evidence_to_store: Query, snippets, site categories, match verdict

name: Reddit, Stack Overflow, Quora and industry forums presence
data_source: Public search results scoped to reddit.com, stackoverflow.com and quora.com
check_logic: Runs one search for the company name scoped to the three community domains and counts discoverable mentions.
scoring: Score scaled from mention count (0 = 15, 1-2 = 40, 3+ = 65; not verified for spam/relevance so capped below 70).
evidence_to_store: Query, mention count, matched URLs

name: YouTube presence and authority footprint
data_source: Public search results scoped to youtube.com
check_logic: Runs one search for the company name scoped to youtube.com and counts discoverable video/channel results; transcript availability is not independently verified.
scoring: Score scaled from result count (0 = 15, 1-2 = 45, 3+ = 65).
evidence_to_store: Query, result count, matched URLs

name: Podcast, webinar and conference footprint indexed/transcribed
check_logic: Search for company/expert appearances; classify event authority, relevance and whether transcript text is indexable.
scoring: Weighted presence score by authority, relevance and transcript availability.
evidence_to_store: Event URL, transcript availability, authority

name: Quality and topical relevance of sites linking to the company
data_source: Public search-result mention count for the domain (no backlink-index API connected)
check_logic: No backlink data provider (Ahrefs/Moz/Majestic) is connected. As a rough proxy, this counts how many independent pages mention the domain in a public search; topical relevance and link authority are not verified.
scoring: Score scaled from mention count, capped at 55 because quality/relevance/follow-nofollow are unverified without a backlink index.
evidence_to_store: Query, mention count, cap note

name: Unlinked brand mentions and earned news by market
data_source: Public search results for the company name excluding the company's own domain
check_logic: Searches for the company name while excluding the company's own domain and counts third-party pages that mention it; whether each mention links back is not individually verified.
scoring: Score scaled from mention count (0 = 15, 1-3 = 40, 4+ = 65).
evidence_to_store: Query, mention count, matched URLs

name: Third-party sites actually cited by AI assistants for target topics
data_source: The engine's own configured LLM, asked which sources it would cite for the site's core topic
check_logic: Asks the configured LLM which real websites it would reference when answering a buyer question about the site's primary category, then checks whether the company's own domain/brand appears among the sources named. This approximates a single assistant's citation behaviour; it is not a multi-assistant citation audit and requires ENABLE_LLM_SCORING to be on.
scoring: Company cited = 70-100 depending on position; not cited but category-relevant sources returned = 30; UNKNOWN when the LLM is unavailable.
evidence_to_store: Prompt topic, cited sources, brand match

name: Presence on best/top/leading service lists
data_source: Search result pages and industry lists
check_logic: Run target queries such as best/top/leading [service] for [industry]; extract list pages; determine whether company is included and accurately categorized.
scoring: Included target lists / qualifying lists × 100; weight by authority.
evidence_to_store: Query, list URL, rank/position, inclusion status

name: Presence on alternatives-to-competitor pages
data_source: Public search results for '<company> alternatives' style queries
check_logic: Searches for the company name paired with 'alternatives'/'alternative to' and checks whether a genuine alternatives-listing page surfaces that includes the company; no fixed competitor list is configured, so this measures inclusion on alternatives pages generally rather than against named competitors.
scoring: Alternatives-style page found mentioning the company = 60-90 by result strength; none found = 20.
evidence_to_store: Query, matched URLs, brand mention

name: Analyst, directory and trade-press coverage + description accuracy
data_source: Public search results for analyst/trade-press coverage of the company
check_logic: Searches for the company alongside analyst/trade-press terms (Gartner, Forrester, IDC, analyst report, industry coverage), and when the LLM is available asks it to judge whether the returned snippets describe the company accurately and consistently with its own site copy.
scoring: Coverage-found score, refined by the LLM's accuracy verdict when usable; capped at 70 without LLM verification.
evidence_to_store: Query, snippets, LLM accuracy verdict
